name: snapdragon-superadmin-service-catalog-ui-e2e
description: Playwright + playwright-bdd e2e harness for the Superadmin Service Catalog console. Ships dark: cluster-dependent scenarios are @skip; the offline-runnable contract is exercised by bddgen + playwright test --list. Same harness shape as the snapdragon.games/e2e + admin-ui leg (workers:1, screenshot/video on, html reporter, per-step PNG AfterStep hook).
